title: Enable a mechanical layer and make it current
summary: Enables a disabled mechanical layer through IPCB_MechanicalLayer.MechLayerEnabled, marks it used and displayed, and makes it current with CurrentLayerV7, showing that the board-level layer calls do not enable the layer.
phrasings: set the current layer to a mechanical layer
check if a mechanical layer is enabled

commands.name: SetLayerVisible
commands.description: Enable a mechanical layer and make it current
commands.params: Layer=<1..16> (default 3)|Current=<V7, Layer or None> (default V7: SetState_CurrentLayerV7; Layer: SetState_Layer on the board, which does not change the current layer; None: skip)|Enable=<True or False> (default True: SetState_MechLayerEnabled(true); False: only the LayerIsUsed calls, which do not enable the layer)

commands.name: GetLayerState
commands.description: Show the state of a mechanical layer
